topics.question: Will the US enter a recession by the end of 2027?
Will Iceland vote pro-Europe (pass the EU membership negotiations referendum)?
topics.explanation: The sources almost certainly differ due to a resolution-criteria mismatch rather than genuine disagreement about the underlying likelihood. Polymarket is likely pricing the probability that such a referendum actually occurs *and* passes within a specific near-term timeframe, whereas Manifold appears to be pricing only the conditional question of whether the pro-EU side *would* win *if* a referendum were held. Iceland currently has no scheduled EU membership referendum, so the unconditional probability (Polymarket's interpretation) is near-zero, while the conditional "if held, would it pass?" probability (Manifold's interpretation) can reasonably be much higher given polling on Icelandic EU sentiment.

criteria_notes.polymarket: The market resolves on any trade at/above $100k; the Yahoo oracle checks daily closes, so a brief intraday spike that does not close above $100k would not auto-resolve YES. Close enough to track together.
